cadence: Weekly during beta, after every production deploy during launch week, and before any public launch approval.
reviewProtocol: Review every production visual QA screenshot for route clarity, brand consistency, text fit, mobile readability, empty/error-state polish, visual hierarchy, and trust. Treat app errors, horizontal overflow, clipped primary text, overlapping controls, broken share affordances, or unexplained pixel diffs on stable shell routes as release-blocking until fixed or explicitly accepted in the risk register.
